## 简体中文

### 修复

- 关闭其中一个窗口后继续显示该应用的窗口预览组，立即移除并以动画收起已关闭的缩略图，仅在最后一个窗口关闭后隐藏预览。
- macOS 拒绝关闭请求时保留当前缩略图；同一应用的预览尺寸变化继续使用动画且不重新引入无变化刷新时的闪烁。

## English

### Fixed

- Kept a window preview group open after closing one of its windows, immediately removed and animated the closed thumbnail out of the group, and dismissed the preview only after its final window closed.
- Preserved the current thumbnail when macOS rejected the close request, and animated same-app preview resizing without reintroducing flashes during unchanged updates.
